\section*{Multiple Choice (10 marks)}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item \duallayerbox{Insulin deficiency is associated with}{Insulin excess is associated with}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Reduced lipolysis
    \item Increased ketogenesis
    \item Reduced gluconeogenesis
    \item Reduced proteolysis
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{The critical pH below which demineralisation of tooth enamel occurs is usually around:}{The typical resting pH of saliva in a healthy mouth is usually around:}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item 6
    \item 5.7
    \item 5.5
    \item 5
\end{enumerate}
\item Which of the following statements about the protein:energy ratio of the requirement is
correct?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Infants and children need the most protein dense food
    \item Children are most susceptible to protein deficient diets
    \item Young adults need the most protein dense food
    \item The elderly need the most protein dense food
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Normal growth can be defined as BMI between:}{Overweight can be defined as BMI centiles between:}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item 75th and 2nd BMI centile
    \item 91st and 2nd BMI centile
    \item 99.6th and 0.4th BMI centile
    \item 75th and 25th BMI centile
\end{enumerate}
\item In order to achieve optimal nutritional status it is recommended that older adults
consume:
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item A high energy content diet.
    \item A high nutrient dense diet.
    \item A low energy content diet.
    \item A daily antioxidant supplement.
\end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}

\section*{True / False (10 marks)}
\textit{Answer True or False}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\setcounter{enumi}{5}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{Type IIb muscle fibers are known for their high fatigue resistance during prolonged activity.}{Type I muscle fibers are known for their high fatigue resistance during prolonged activity.}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{Superoxide dismutase is a zinc-dependent enzyme that helps protect cells from damage.}{Superoxide dismutase is an enzyme that helps protect cells from damage caused by superoxide radicals.}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{The four-compartment model is the most accurate method to estimate changes in body fat during weight loss.}{The skinfold thickness method is the most accurate way to estimate changes in body fat during weight loss.}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{A person is considered overweight if their BMI is greater than or equal to 25 kg/m2.}{A person is considered overweight if their BMI is greater than or equal to 25 kg/m2 according to WHO criteria.}
\item True or False: High protein diets support weight loss and maintenance through mechanisms like GLP-1, PYY, and a higher thermic effect.
\end{enumerate}
